title: Actor RoleBinding Contract
summary: Bind party and actor roles to tenant, channel and app context only; identity lifecycle and policy evaluation stay outside.

criteria: A RoleBinding attaches exactly one party and one actor to one role within a declared tenant, channel and app scope; a binding without a complete scope is refused.
The same party may hold different roles in different scopes, so a role is never global: resolution always answers within one tenant, channel and app triple.
Binding resolution is default-deny: when no binding matches the requested scope the answer is an empty role set, never an inherited or ambient role.
The contract declares what a binding IS; whether a bound role may perform an action is a policy evaluation owned by the PDP and is never decided here.
identity lifecycle, including SSO/OIDC/MFA registration, credential rotation and account deactivation, stays outside this contract and is only referenced as an external precondition.
Every binding create, change and revoke is tenant-scoped and recorded append-only, and a cross-tenant binding attempt is refused rather than silently narrowed.

risks.desc: A binding that resolves outside its declared tenant, channel or app scope would grant a role in a context nobody reviewed, which is a silent privilege escalation.
risks.mitigation: Require a complete scope on every binding, resolve strictly within one tenant, channel and app triple and keep cross-tenant refusal a fixed negative-test axis.

risks.desc: Treating an unmatched scope as an inherited or ambient role would turn a missing binding into an accidental grant across the whole platform.
risks.mitigation: Fix resolution at default-deny with an empty role set, and prove the empty answer with a dedicated negative rather than assuming a fallback.

risks.desc: A RoleBinding contract could be misread as deciding authorization, so a bound role would be treated as an allow without any policy evaluation.
risks.mitigation: State in every phase that a bound role is an input to the PDP and never a decision, and keep authorization-decision-contract as the named decision owner.

risks.desc: Absorbing identity lifecycle would duplicate SSO/OIDC/MFA and credential ownership and create two competing sources of truth for who a party is.
risks.mitigation: Keep identity lifecycle an explicit exclusion referenced as a precondition, and preserve NO-GO without new human authority.

featureDefs.title: Özellik Tanımları
items: A RoleBinding joins one party, one actor and one role inside a declared tenant, channel and app scope with a validity window.
Girdi is a party or actor reference plus a scope triple; çıktı is the bound role set for exactly that scope, or an empty set under default-deny.
A role is never global, so the same party may hold different roles per scope and no binding is inherited across a tenant, channel or app boundary.
Binding create, change and revoke are append-only, which keeps a historical authorization context reconstructable without rewriting the record.
Kapsam sınırı gereği identity lifecycle including SSO/OIDC/MFA stays outside and policy evaluation stays with the PDP.

security.title: Güvenlik Önlemleri
items: Scope completeness is the primary control: a binding without a tenant, channel and app scope is refused, so no role can be granted in an unreviewed context.
Resolution is default-deny, so an unmatched scope yields an empty role set rather than an inherited or ambient role that nobody approved.
Every binding is bound to one tenant and a cross-tenant create, read or resolution is refused rather than filtered, which preserves izolasyon.
A bound role is an input to an authorization decision and never the decision itself; policy evaluation stays with the PDP, which keeps the security boundary single-owner.
Binding create, change and revoke are recorded append-only with actor attribution, which keeps a privilege change auditable as a denetim trail.

security.prompt: Actor RoleBinding Contract security kapsamı. Kapsa: mandatory complete scope, default-deny resolution, tenant-bound bindings, binding-is-not-a-decision boundary, append-only privilege audit. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

codeOptimization.title: Kod Optimizasyonu
items: The planned handoff keeps one typed resolution katman for every scope rather than a per-channel resolver, so binding semantics cannot diverge between surfaces.
Scope matching and role set assembly stay pure functions with low cyclomatic complexity, testable without a datastore.
Binding and policy evaluation stay separated; ölü kod and speculative per-app role models are refused, and engineering rules are reached through standardRefs rather than restated here.

securityOptimization.title: Güvenlik Optimizasyonu
items: The role reference set is closed and owned externally, so introducing a role is a reviewed change rather than something a binding request can invent.
Least ayrıcalık applies per scope: a binding grants a role in exactly one tenant, channel and app triple and never widens to a sibling scope.
A binding validity window bounds exposure in time, so a temporary elevation expires by construction instead of relying on a manual revoke.

The binding surface stays kapalı: the resolver exposes no egress path to an external directory and its reachable yüzey is the declared scope triple, so a compromised consumer cannot widen what it can read.
securityOptimization.notes: actor-role-binding-contract/securityOptimization: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
securityOptimization.prompt: Actor RoleBinding Contract securityOptimization kapsamı. Kapsa: externally owned closed role set, per-scope least privilege, time-bounded binding validity. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

performance.title: Performans Optimizasyonu
items: A p95 budget is declared for a single scope resolution on a representative binding set; no measurement is claimed here.
Resolution is expected on every request path, so the declared budget treats it as a hot lookup rather than an occasional administrative query.
Scope resolution must avoid N+1 lookups; the binding set for a party is fetched once per resolution rather than once per candidate role.
performance.notes: actor-role-binding-contract/performance: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
performance.prompt: Actor RoleBinding Contract performance kapsamı. Kapsa: p95 budget for scope resolution, hot-path treatment, N+1-free binding lookup. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

mobileApps.title: Mobil Uygulama Uyumu
items: A mobil client consumes a resolved role set for its own scope; a cihaz may not assemble or cache a role set as authoritative for another scope.
An offline client displays the last synchronised role set as stale together with its scope, rather than assuming a binding is still valid.
No mobile binding administration surface is introduced here; rendering a resolved role set stays a separate consumer responsibility.
mobileApps.notes: actor-role-binding-contract/mobileApps: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
mobileApps.prompt: Actor RoleBinding Contract mobileApps kapsamı. Kapsa: server-authoritative role resolution, stale offline display with scope, no mobile binding administration here. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

wcag.title: WCAG 2.2 AAA
items: Any future binding administration surface must present the party, actor, role and scope triple as keyboard navigable content with a visible odak ring at the AAA kontrast threshold.
A binding refusal, such as an incomplete scope or a cross-tenant attempt, must be announced through an aria live region naming the failing scope field.
This contract defines binding semantics only, so no accessibility conformance may be recorded here and every such result stays planned.
wcag.notes: actor-role-binding-contract/wcag: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
wcag.prompt: Actor RoleBinding Contract wcag kapsamı. Kapsa: keyboard-navigable binding presentation, announced binding refusals, semantics-only scope. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

deployment.title: Dağıtım (Swarm/K8s/Shared)
items: This shard performs no release or deploy; any future Kubernetes topology for a binding resolution service remains human-developer work.
Creating or revoking a binding is a data-level change behind human approval and must not require a container rebuild; rollback returns to the previous binding state.
Backing this binding shard out is a plan-level revert of the contract text plus the files regenerated from it, with no stored binding altered, so runtimeDataImpact stays none and NO-GO still holds.
deployment.notes: actor-role-binding-contract/deployment: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
deployment.prompt: Actor RoleBinding Contract deployment kapsamı. Kapsa: no release or deploy here, binding changes as approved data changes, bounded withdrawal. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

eca.title: ECA Kuralları
items: A binding create or revoke olay may notify downstream consumers, but this contract never performs a business action of its own on that event.
A binding change that triggers a downstream re-resolution forms a chain that stops at maxChainDepth 6, so a privilege change cannot cascade without bound.
Re-delivering the same binding event for the same binding version must be idempotent, and any privilege elevation always requires an explicit onay.
eca.notes: actor-role-binding-contract/eca: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
eca.prompt: Actor RoleBinding Contract eca kapsamı. Kapsa: binding events without acting, depth-bounded re-resolution chains, idempotent replay and approval-gated elevation. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

aiAgents.title: AI Ajan Davranışı
items: An AI lane is limited to reading this contract and drafting a changeset; app or module generation, app or module update, ruleset override and direct production write all stay forbidden actions ve yasak kalır.
AI cannot create, widen or revoke a RoleBinding and cannot resolve a scope on its own authority; each of those needs insan onayı, and a privilege elevation additionally requires a step-up review.

Any binding request reaching the lane as sub_prompt is untrusted, the kill switch stays reachable, and no prompt or repository prose may widen this shard's fixed D01 scope or claim an unexecuted test result.
aiAgents.notes: actor-role-binding-contract/aiAgents: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
aiAgents.prompt: Actor RoleBinding Contract aiAgents kapsamı. Kapsa: read and draft-changeset only, AI barred from creating, widening or revoking bindings, untrusted sub_prompt and kill switch. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

testing.title: Testler & QA
items: Planned positive cases bind a party and actor to a role in a tenant, channel and app scope and resolve the same role set back, as unit and integration matrices.
Planned negatives prove an incomplete scope is refused before storage and that an unmatched scope resolves to an empty role set under default-deny.
Planned negatives prove a cross-tenant binding create, read or resolution is refused rather than narrowed.
Planned boundary cases prove a bound role never produces an allow on its own, keeping policy evaluation with the PDP.
These binding matrices are plans rather than evidence: a pass is recordable only after a human-approved execution has genuinely run.
testing.notes: actor-role-binding-contract/testing: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
testing.prompt: Actor RoleBinding Contract testing kapsamı. Kapsa: scope binding and resolution positives, incomplete-scope and default-deny negatives, cross-tenant negatives, binding-is-not-a-decision boundary cases. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

owasp.title: OWASP & Standartlar
items: OWASP A01 broken access control is the defining axis: bindings are scope-complete and tenant-bound, and resolution is default-deny so a missing binding never becomes a grant.
OWASP A04 insecure design is modeled by declaring the scope triple, the validity window and the binding-is-not-a-decision boundary up front rather than patching them later.
OWASP A09 security logging failures is modeled by recording every binding create, change and revoke append-only with actor attribution.

Girdi doğrulama applies to every binding request: the scope triple, party, actor and role references are validated against closed reference sets before storage, and each accepted or refused binding leaves a denetim izi.
owasp.notes: actor-role-binding-contract/owasp: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
owasp.prompt: Actor RoleBinding Contract owasp kapsamı. Kapsa: A01 via scope-complete tenant-bound default-deny bindings, A04 via declared scope and boundary design, A09 via append-only privilege logging. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

integration.title: Kernel/Core Entegrasyonu
items: Kernel integration is contributor -> app-kernel/k-archetype-fieldtypes with contributionKind specification, targetProviderIds [k-party] and runtimeProviderClaimAllowed=false.
The parent k-actor is itself a contributor routed to k-party, so this descendant inherits that provider target rather than claiming its own parent id as a provider.
All three publicBoundary flags stay false, so a binding touches no kernel internal, no kernel database and no cross-context write path; a change notification arrives as an olay instead.
This schedule is only a planning window; predecessor party-role-context-contract ends 2028-04-30, so no executable-order or readiness claim is allowed.
dependsOn stays exactly party-role-context-contract and authorization-decision-contract, and the parent-only k-identity edge and its related list are not inherited.

Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

moduleUsage.title: Modül Kullanımı
items: A consuming module tüketir a resolved role set through this contract and may not maintain its own role table or reach a doğrudan tablo for bindings.
A consumer must carry the scope triple alongside any stored role decision, so a later audit can tell which binding context produced it.
Defining a party or a role belongs to party-role-context-contract and deciding an action belongs to authorization-decision-contract; this contract binds only.

Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

dataLifecycle.title: Veri Yaşam Döngüsü & Uyum
items: A binding names a party and therefore exposes PII indirectly, so KVKK/GDPR veri sınıflandırması, purpose, owner and retention approval are required before implementation; DSAR silme veya anonimleştirme yolu istenir.

A revoked binding is retained for its declared saklama süresi so a historical authorization context stays explainable, while the underlying identity record removal stays an external owner's obligation.
Bindings and their audit records are retained append-only, and stored bindings evolve by expand-contract rather than in-place rewrite.

dataLifecycle.prompt: Actor RoleBinding Contract dataLifecycle kapsamı. Kapsa: indirect PII through party references, retention of revoked bindings, append-only history and expand-contract evolution. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

observability.title: Gözlemlenebilirlik & Operasyon
items: Planned SLI/SLO metrics include scope resolution latency percentiles, empty-result rates by scope kind and refused binding counts by failing rule on tenant-safe labels.
Structured log and trace records carry the scope triple and the binding version; party identifiers and role payloads are redacted and never become metric labels.
Alerts cover a spike in cross-tenant binding refusals, an unexpected surge of empty resolutions and repeated privilege elevation attempts; thresholds and the runbook require human approval.
observability.notes: actor-role-binding-contract/observability: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
observability.prompt: Actor RoleBinding Contract observability kapsamı. Kapsa: resolution and refusal SLIs, redacted scope-carrying traces, cross-tenant and elevation alerts with a human-approved runbook. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

reliability.title: Dayanıklılık & Süreklilik
items: The primary failure mode is an unreachable binding store during resolution; the contract degrades to an explicit default-deny empty role set, never to a cached permissive answer.
Resolution is idempotent by construction: the same party and scope against the same binding version always returns the same role set, so a retry with bounded backoff cannot drift a privilege.
A repeatedly failing binding change is routed to a dead-letter path for human review rather than retried forever, and a circuit breaker protects the shared resolver.

reliability.prompt: Actor RoleBinding Contract reliability kapsamı. Kapsa: fail-closed empty resolution on store failure, idempotent resolution with bounded retry, dead-letter routing and circuit-breaker protection. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.
